name: Immune-Mediated Necrotizing Myopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: European Neuromuscular Centre (ENMC) 2017 Criteria for IMNM

criteria.description: Subacute proximal muscle weakness with elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) levels
Muscle biopsy showing necrosis and regeneration of muscle fibers with minimal inflammatory infiltrate
Presence of specific myositis-associated autoantibodies such as anti-SRP or anti-HMGCR
Exclusion of other inflammatory myopathies such as dermatomyositis or polymyositis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of subacute proximal muscle weakness with elevated CK, characteristic muscle biopsy findings, and detection of specific autoantibodies
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other inflammatory myopathies and consideration of clinical context.

searchTerms: proximal muscle weakness developing over weeks

pathognomonic.symptomName: Markedly elevated serum creatine kinase levels
Muscle fiber necrosis with minimal inflammatory infiltrate on biopsy
searchTerms: muscle cell death with little inflammation
muscle tissue damage without much immune cells

common.symptomName: Presence of anti-SRP or anti-HMGCR autoantibodies

searchTerms: difficulty breathing due to muscle weakness

laboratory: Elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) often >10 times upper limit of normal
Presence of anti-SRP or anti-HMGCR autoantibodies
imaging: Muscle MRI showing muscle edema and fatty replacement
Chest imaging to evaluate for interstitial lung disease if respiratory symptoms present
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; autoimmune etiology
other: Muscle biopsy demonstrating necrotic and regenerating fibers with minimal inflammatory infiltrate

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic heliotrope rash and Gottron papules
More prominent perivascular inflammation on biopsy
More prominent endomysial inflammatory infiltrate on biopsy
Absence of necrosis as predominant feature
May overlap with anti-HMGCR positive IMNM

redFlags: Rapidly progressive muscle weakness leading to respiratory failure
Severe dysphagia with risk of aspiration
Markedly elevated CK with signs of rhabdomyolysis
references: Allenbach Y, et al. Immune-mediated necrotizing myopathies: clinical features and pathogenesis. Nat Rev Rheumatol. 2020.
European Neuromuscular Centre (ENMC) 2017 International Workshop on Immune-Mediated Necrotizing Myopathies.
Lindberg C, et al. Autoantibodies in immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy. Autoimmun Rev. 2019.
